u0: Initial state: the agent has not yet held the matching key. Progress: no key acquired. Next objective: locate and pick up the key that matches the locked door's color, then keep carrying it while making further moves.
u1: The agent has held the matching key for one qualifying move. Progress: first key-held step achieved; key must remain in hand and the door must stay closed. If the key is lost before the door opens, fall back to u0. Next objective: continue carrying the key for at least one more move to reach u2.
u2: The agent has held the matching key on two or more different moves while the door is still closed. Progress: key-carry requirement satisfied. If the key is lost before opening the door, fall back to u0. Next objective: move to face the locked door and toggle it open with the key in hand.
u3: The agent has unlocked and opened the door while still carrying the matching key. Progress: door now open. Next objective: drop the key (without losing door_access) so the agent's hands are free, reaching u4. If the door closes or the state otherwise regresses, return to u2.
u4: The agent has opened the door and no longer carries the key, so its hands are free to take the box. Progress: inside or able to enter the target room. Next objective: navigate to the mission's designated box and pick it up, completing the task at u5. If the door relationship or key state regresses, return to u2.
u5: Terminal success state: the agent carries the mission's target box with the door open. Progress: all reward-machine objectives complete; the episode ends. No further objective remains.
